propositions: Unlocked mirror-sweep resolutions float anthropic to 1.2.0, which vendors httpx2 and rejects stdlib httpx.AsyncClient, causing the provider seam to raise TypeError: Invalid http_client argument when constructing AsyncAnthropic
pyproject.toml declares pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic] without a direct upper bound on anthropic SDK, allowing unbounded resolution to httpx2-vendoring releases (1.0.0+)

The declared lower-bound resolution leg (--resolution lowest-direct) without an explicit anthropic floor would drop to an ancient incompatible version; a ranged constraint (floor and ceiling) is required to pin both highest and lowest paths
Adding anthropic>=0.121.0,<1 to [agents] extra bounds the SDK below the httpx2-vendoring line (first httpx2 release is 1.0.0) and matches the locked compatible version
A packaging unit test must verify the declared anthropic specifier admits 0.121.0 (stdlib-httpx) and rejects 1.0.0/1.2.0 (httpx2), failing RED if the ceiling is removed
